# Nunik Co.

> AI agency based in Australia, working with growth-focused businesses anywhere. We build custom automations, brand identity systems and high-performance websites for trades, hospitality, automotive, real estate, and food and beverage.

Nunik Co. is a South Asian heritage digital collective based in Canberra, Australia, delivering remotely worldwide. We work with anyone, anywhere, on one condition: you want execution like no one else. We operate under three principles: Yukti (automation), Rasa (brand), Artha (web and consulting). Contact: hello@nunik.co.

## Services
- [Automation (Yukti)](https://nunik.co/services/automation/): n8n workflow development, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM setup and integration, Zapier and Make automation, API and webhook systems, Airtable and PostgreSQL databases.
- [Brand (Rasa)](https://nunik.co/services/brand/): logo and brand mark systems, full Tech Pack delivery, marketing collateral, UX and UI design, social media templates.
- [Web (Artha)](https://nunik.co/services/web/): custom websites in React, Next.js and WordPress, SEO and performance, marketing strategy consulting, staff training.

## Industries

- [Industries hub](https://nunik.co/industries/): all three branches in one place (trades, hospitality, automotive).

### Trades
- [Trades hub](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/): all trade specialisations, problem-first.
- [Pest Control](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/pest-control/): quarterly callbacks, recurring contracts, treatment selection, SMS reminders.
- [Electrical](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/electrical/): COES compliance, after-hours intake, customer portal with photos and certificates.
- [Plumbing](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/plumbing/): after-hours triage, geofenced routing, automated payment links.
- [Cleaning](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/cleaning/): recurring bookings, route optimisation, instant invoicing.
- [Landscaping](https://nunik.co/industries/trades/landscaping/): quote-to-job-to-invoice, seasonal contract renewals, crew dispatch.

### Hospitality
- [Hospitality hub](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/): brand-led venues and service businesses across Australia.
- [Restaurants](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/restaurants/): reservation automation, menu management, review cycle CRM.
- [Salons](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/salons/): stylist-specific bookings, colour formula records, loyalty stamps, SMS confirmations.
- [Hotels](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/hotels/): direct booking that beats OTA margin, channel manager sync, guest journey CRM.
- [Travel Agencies](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/travel-agencies/): quote-to-itinerary pipelines, supplier coordination, repeat-client trip automation.
- [Massage and Wellness](https://nunik.co/industries/hospitality/massage-parlours/): online booking by therapist, intake automation, memberships, HICAPS receipting.

### Automotive
- [Automotive hub](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/): mechanic and vehicle-fleet operations.
- [Auto Repair](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/auto-repair/): online booking, SMS quote approvals, customer portal, service reminder automation.
- [Mobile Scratch and Dent](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/scratch-and-dent/): photo-based quoting, geo-dispatch to nearest tech, fleet and dealership flows.
- [Towing](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/towing/): 24/7 dispatch, pickup-to-yard tracking, multi-payer invoicing.
- [Removalists](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/removalists/): guided inventory quoting, crew job sheets, damage capture, repeat-move CRM.
- [Car Washing and Detailing](https://nunik.co/industries/automotive/car-washing/): online booking, membership plans, up-sell automation, mobile route optimisation.

Other sectors served: real estate, allied health, founder and product brands.

## Locations
- [Canberra (home base)](https://nunik.co/locations/canberra/): hospitality, trades, allied health, founder brands across the ACT. Remote delivery worldwide from this base.
